definitions.gloss: the second-in-command of a sports team or similar group, who assists the captain and takes over when the captain is absent
definitions.explanation: Formed by attaching the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-) to キャプテン (captain). Used mainly in sports teams — baseball, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and so on — as well as in school clubs and some student-government and youth-group contexts. The {副|ふく}キャプテン is chosen to support the captain in leading the team and to step in as acting captain when the captain is absent or unable to play.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副|ふく}キャプテンだ。
examples.english: He is the vice-captain of the soccer club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{副|ふく}キャプテン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I have been made vice-captain starting this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠場|けつじょう}→欠場：18521_ketsujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{副|ふく}キャプテン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: Because the captain was out, the vice-captain held the team together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧になって⟦バスケットボール→バスケットボール：04724_basukettobooru⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副|ふく}キャプテン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧、⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: In her third year she was chosen as vice-captain of the basketball club, and she takes good care of the younger members.

notes:
Compound of the prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- (vice-, deputy-, assistant-) + the loanword ⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧ (captain). The ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- prefix is attached to many role and title words to indicate a second-in-command position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副|ふく}キャプテン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as vice-captain
- {副|ふく}キャプテン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be chosen as vice-captain
- {副|ふく}キャプテン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as vice-captain
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副|ふく}キャプテン: the team's vice-captain

RELATED ROLE TERMS:
- ⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧: captain (of a sports team or group)
- ⟦{主将|しゅしょう}→主将：16187_shushou⟧: team captain — the traditional Sino-Japanese equivalent of ⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧, common in written sports coverage.
- ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧{主将|ふくしゅしょう}: vice-captain — the Sino-Japanese equivalent of {副|ふく}キャプテン; used interchangeably in many contexts.
- ⟦{副|ふく}{部長|ぶちょう}→副部長：23994_fukubuchou⟧: vice-president of a club (more administrative than team-oriented)

REGISTER:
Neutral. {副|ふく}キャプテン is common in everyday conversation, school-club contexts, and the popular press, while ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧⟦{主将|しゅしょう}→主将：16187_shushou⟧ tends to appear in more formal sports reporting and official team rosters.

THE PREFIX {副|ふく}-:
The same prefix yields a wide set of "vice-" or "deputy" titles:
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice president (of a company)
- ⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧: vice chairperson
- {副大統領|ふくだいとうりょう}: vice president (of a country)
- ⟦{副校長|ふくこうちょう}→副校長：23995_fukukouchou⟧: vice principal
